premises.text: Doctors make bad decisions because they cannot feed clinical experience back into reference tools
premises.evidence_span: Good doctors, like me and Mark, wind up making bad decisions because we have no way to share our experience

premises.text: A platform structures and shares doctors' experience with upvote-ranked treatments, dosing detail, and peer comments
premises.evidence_span: share practice structures and shares doctor's experience

premises.text: Built-in sharing to doctor contacts virally acquires new users while capturing structured answers
premises.evidence_span: Viral model is baked right in, and it's working beautifully

premises.text: A proprietary medical ontology unifies variance in medical terminology across diagnosis and treatment databases
premises.evidence_span: SharePractice built a proprietary medical ontology that took multiple databases, treatment databases, diagnosis databases, put them all together

premises.text: The platform uniquely captures why doctors choose particular treatments, data valuable in the analytics market

value.text: Patients get the best treatment because every doctor can draw on a large shared pool of clinical experience
value.evidence_span: share practice puts a million doctors in every doctor's pocket, and you're going to get the benefit of all of that experience

secondary_value.text: Global doctor collaboration may surface new cures and better treatment knowledge
secondary_value.evidence_span: global collaboration of doctors sharing their experience
